requires_before_execution: Implement source-only cache/layout inspection and CPU diagnostic code
Synthetic numerical checks, exact factor/gauge semantics and memory-bounded loading
Freeze a separate executable diagnostic registration binding code/runtime/checkpoint/config/selected artifact bytes
Commit before decoding additional adapter/cache tensors for this diagnostic
hypothesis_questions: Are LoRA factor changes producing measurable weight/function changes?
How much fixed-input self-camera axial-depth change is a per-view or per-pair scalar component?
Do saved raw network changes survive canonical/native/final processing? D0 only quantifies available components; it cannot prove the full training-surrogate response.

immutable_model.effective_update: DeltaW=(alpha/r)*B@A; original zero-B initialization means initial DeltaW=0

report: relative norm against corresponding frozen base weight
aggregate norm over adapted matrices only
adapter_norm_scope.formula: ||BA||_F^2=tr((B^T B)(A A^T)); validate against directly materialized products on synthetic fixtures; preserve undefined zero-denominator cases

functional_scope.selection_rule: first scene and source in frozen M2 registration, smaller numeric full-gradient arm; no selection by score
functional_scope.same_state_comparator_condition: Prove from bound writer source that these cache tensors depend only on identical RGB/model inputs before any supplied-prior/native optimization; compare raw forward tensors only, not native endpoints.
functional_scope.outputs: self-camera axial depth from saved fresh-FP32 raw forward outputs; exact field and shape mapping must be source-verified before execution registration
functional_scope.additional_coordinates: all permitted earlier-source adaptation pixels, kept separate from the fixed image grid; no opposite-source measurements
functional_scope.aggregation: retain each directed-pair/view result; aggregate equally across directed pairs, never choose a best pair
functional_scope.scalar_decomposition: delta=d1-d0; a=(d0^T delta)/(d0^T d0); delta_shape=delta-a*d0 on exactly the declared coordinate set
functional_scope.interpretation: Unlabeled diagnostic decomposition only; never replace an evaluated prediction, refit an accuracy metric or treat the secant as a LoRA Jacobian.
functional_scope.invalid_policy: count and preserve nonfinite/nonpositive values; do not shrink coordinate sets; undefined denominator remains undefined

forbidden: No opposite-source measurement packet for the selected functional case
No new GPU model forwards in D0
No M3 or paid transfer release
No replacing the failed screen or reclassifying development scenes as final tests
output_requirements: All declared adapter and fixed-case statistics including failures
Recorded CPU time/peak host memory and zero GPU/rental use
A reasoned diagnosis distinguishing weight-space norm, raw-function change, scalar component and unresolved downstream effects
If more evidence is needed, prospectively specify a bounded no-update D1 probe; do not silently enlarge D0
Choose and register at most one targeted redesign only after diagnostic evidence; preserve initial negative result
